name: Main_Loop
note: boot, then the per-frame loop: tasks, frame blend, display swap

name: TitleSeq_Task
note: state machine: logos, title, attract demo, main menu

name: Logo_ConspiracyTask
note: SYS/LOGO.GSL 384x384 at (128 32); 244 frames

name: Logo_TakaraTask
note: SYS/TAKARA.E3D zoom and unrotate; 165 frames

name: Title_PressStartTask
note: SYS/TITLE.GSL background and plate; PRESS START blink, its text by D_00333284 (EN D_002EA090, FR D_002EA0A8, DE D_002EA0C8; the Language extra)

name: Title_AttractDemoTask
note: the attract demo: race mode 8, Race_Setup on Adventure row 24 (Endurance Run) to REPLAY.TSQ; NOW LOADING over the held title (8/128 a frame); song fade at 3600, black over 64 frames, ends at 3664 (Race::StartDemo; title.md); the Demo Song extra loads DEMO.TSQ (0x0A1B0201) instead

name: Title_MainMenuTask
note: main menu window: Adventure; Quick Race; 2 Player (second pad only); Options; Results

name: Fade_InTask
note: overlay alpha (32-t)*4 (or (64-t)*2)

name: Fade_OutTask
note: overlay alpha t*4 (or t*2)

name: Fade_SetOverlay
note: full-screen colour overlay (RGBA word)

name: Frame_BlendPrevious
note: draws the previous frame over the new one (FIX 0x20)

name: Text_Print
note: text at cell (col row): x = col*20+10; y = (row*12+5)*2

name: Text_DrawGlyph
note: one glyph from SYS/FONTE.GSL (16x24 cells; width table 0x0029A860); the accent escapes / ` ^ ~ before a letter use the Latin-1 cells at v 0x60-0x90 (~R the registered sign)

name: Sound_Init
note: binds the SNDMOD RPC; sets up bank slots: CQ_MAIN 0; ROOM_1 1; ACTION 3 (BGM.TVB in 1 and 2)

name: Sound_Request
note: RPC 0xD (sddrSoftData): play sequence (slot<<8|entry); bit 15 stops it; pan in the top half

name: Sound_PlaySe
note: Sound_Request(id | 0x40400000): centre pan

name: Sound_LoadSong
note: arg = file<<16 | slot<<8 | entry: load a TSQ from the file table (D_0029ADF0) and select the song

name: Sound_StartSong
note: RPC 0xE (sddrSongData) 1

name: Sound_StopSong
note: RPC 0xE (sddrSongData) 2

name: Options_MenuTask
note: Options: Vibration; Speaker; Sound Volume; Exit, items 0-2 and 4 of D_0029AC90 + 0x14 x D_00333284 (Language, +0xC, is left out in the US build and has no task; the Language extra adds it and the PC's window, Options_LanguageTask)

name: Pad_Vibrate
note: start a vibration pattern (D_0029AD60) on a pad if its mode & the setting, strength capped at 0xFF

name: Pad_VibrationTask
note: steps the patterns a frame; motors held off after 180 frames running until 360

name: Options_VibrationTask
note: vibration mode in the pad state +0x0E: 4 on; 0 off; 2 ANALOG button; TEST rumbles; lines D_0029AC40 + 0x14 x D_00333284

name: Options_SpeakerTask
note: Stereo/Mono via Sound_SetSpeaker; plays 0x1F

name: Options_VolumeTask
note: six steps in D_00333290; master volume (5-step)*0x3FFF/5; plays 0x2F

name: Title_ResultsTask
note: darkens the title (overlay up to 0x40, kept) and runs the memory card screens (func_00228D10, the load into record 0); a save loaded: VersusRecords_Task; else back to the main menu

name: Window_AddLine
note: appends a line (flags: 0x10 item; 0x80 same line; 2 current; 1 disabled; 8 right); grows the window

name: Window_Place
note: bits 0-1 horizontal (centre/left/right); bits 2-3 vertical (centre/top/lower half)

name: Window_UpdateList
note: draws a window and runs its cursor; returns 1 chosen; -1 cancel; -2 closed; arg2 = scroll list

name: Window_Update
note: Window_UpdateList without a scroll list

name: Window_DrawFrame
note: nine-slice frame from SYS/FONTE.GSL (u 0x12C palette 8; u 0x104 palettes 14/7)

name: Window_DrawBar
note: highlight bar (u 0x180; palette 11)

name: Window_DrawCursor
note: horn cursor (u 0x150 v 0xE0 38x28; palette 13)

name: Menu_MoveCursor
note: grid cursor from the pad: presses wrap; repeats stop at the ends; plays 0x1D

name: Help_Draw
note: button hints box at the top right (strings D_0029A8E0 + 0x14 x D_00333284: English, French, German)

name: Text_PrintAt
note: text at pixel x and half-line y

name: Text_Width
note: width of a string in pixels (two-byte characters 20)

name: Sound_SetMasterVolume
note: SPU2 core 1 MVOLL/MVOLR

name: Sound_SetSpeaker
note: RPC 8 cmd 0: 0 stereo; 1 mono

name: Sound_GetSpeaker
note: RPC 8 cmd 1

name: WindowAlloc
note: takes a free window of the 8 at D_0034A3C0; centred on (320 112)

name: Title_AdventureMenuTask
note: New Game / Continue (D_0029ACE0 + 8 x D_00333284) over the dimmed title; result to the root task

name: NameEntry_Task
note: text entry task; argument = mode (0 name; 1 currency unit; 2 greeting; table D_002C40D0)

name: NameEntry_CloseTask
note: fades the entry out over 16 frames; then tells the parent

name: NameEntry_MoveCursor
note: keyboard moves from D_002C3B10 (0x8000 = wrap; press only); plays 0x1D

name: NameEntry_Input
note: Cross types (0x22) / Cancel deletes / Apply finishes (0x1A); Triangle deletes (0x1B)

name: NameEntry_DrawKeyboard
note: 92 keys in a style-2 window; 18 px columns; palette 10

name: NameEntry_DrawPrompt
note: prompt box with one * slot per character

name: NewGame_Task
note: starts name entry and loading; then currency (0x0026D5E0); then the opening scene (0x0026D628)

name: NewGame_AfterName
note: name done: starts the currency entry

name: NewGame_AfterCurrency
note: currency done: starts the opening scene (func_00211708)

name: NewGame_Setup
note: Save_InitBoth, then player 1 starts with one of six bodies (0x2B, 0, 0x75, 0x8C, 0x72, 0x5D) picked by info+0 (the frames since boot) mod 6 (func_0027AFD8, 0x0026D460), and the meter loads; then NewGame_Task

name: QuickRace_Task
note: Quick Race root: loads the course select, takes its course (or -1: QuickRace_ExitFadeTask)

name: QuickRace_ExitFadeTask
note: black overlay t*2 over 64 frames, then result 0 to the root (back to the title)

name: CourseSelect_Task
note: carousel of course cards over scrolling clouds; mask of cards by mode (Quick Race 0x40FF)

name: CourseSelect_DrawCard
note: queues one card: frame, name, then the 3D course view or a S02.GSL picture

name: CourseSelect_PlaceCard
note: card frame (SELECT.GSL 0) at x+-128, y..y+216 scaled; grey cos*16+0x60, 0x80 at the front

name: CourseSelect_PlaceName
note: name plate (SELECT.GSL 1 row id) at x+-96, y+12..y+40 scaled

name: CourseSelect_PlacePicture
note: picture card (S02.GSL) at x+-110, y+50..y+206 scaled

name: CourseSelect_PlaceCourseView
note: 3D view of the miniature course (S00/S01.E3D) in the card window: camera, centre, scissor

name: CourseSelect_InitNames
note: name plate UVs: row (id + j/2) * 28 of 1024

name: CourseSelect_InitPictures
note: picture TEX0s: S02.GSL picture D_002A8BF0[i], 184 blocks apart from 0x285E

name: CourseSelect_SetQuad
note: sets a sprite quad corners from a rect and z

name: CourseInfo_Task
note: chosen course: info fades in over 16; Cross (t>16) races, Triangle back

name: CourseInfo_DrawCourse
note: Track length, laps, Entry cars box

name: CourseInfo_DrawRecords
note: Quick Race (mode 1): player 1's name, then the card's save record +0xB78 + 0xC card: attempts, best total (+4), best lap (+0), best place (D_002A8ED0 or ' --')

name: CourseInfo_DrawAttempts
note: Challenge attempts line

name: CourseSelect_QuitTask
note: Exit card: Quit Games Yes/No; Yes -> result 2

name: Dialog_YesNoTask
note: window: prompt line + Yes/No (default No); result sel, Triangle = No

name: Loading_DrawTask
note: NOW LOADING at (12,10); first 64 frames keep the last picture under a 6/128 black overlay

name: Number_PrintRight
note: large 16x20 digits right-aligned (y in half-lines)

name: Number_PrintDigits
note: large digits, fixed count with leading zeros (y in pixels + 2)

name: Text_PrintSmall
note: narrow 10x20 font; ' " - from the main font

name: Time_Print
note: frames as M'SS"CC; 0x7FFFFFFF --'--"--

name: Help_DrawButton
note: green BACK/OK plates 84x32 from FONTE palette 2

name: Window_DrawCellFrame
note: Window_DrawFrame around text cells col..col2, row..row2; a 5th argument, the style, passes through in $t0

name: Camera_RotationFromAngles
note: camera axes from the s16 pitch (+0x14) and yaw (+0x16): Ry(yaw) Rx(pitch), optionally times a target matrix

name: Camera_ViewMatrix
note: view matrix from the camera rotation and position; with a buffer also the frustum planes (D_0029CF40)

name: Camera_BuildMatrices
note: camera struct (pos, focal +0x10, angles) to the VU1 screen/clip matrices; focal x 1, y 0.47 (field)

name: Camera_SetScreenCenter
note: projection centre in GS coordinates (D_003356E0/E4)

name: Vu1Packet_UploadCamera
note: UNPACK 15 qwords to VU1 M[4..0x12]: the camera matrices

name: Vu1Packet_UploadLighting
note: UNPACK 3 qwords to VU1 M[0x13..0x15], which setup loads to vf09-11: colour weights, then the distance cue (alpha fade, fog) sets

name: Vu1Packet_RunSetup
note: MSCAL setup 0x00 with BASE 0x8D / OFFSET 0x1AE

name: Vu1Packet_SetOffset
note: UNPACK 1 qword to VU1 M[0x1A]: the position offset programs 0x30/0x40 add (vf31)

name: Loader_LoadCourse
note: reads COURSE/Cnn.BIN: GS textures, the field (model table relocated to D_0177AB20[2]), PMP collision (+0x70), map (D_0177AB70), objects

name: Car_Init
note: sets up a car (0x270 bytes at D_0177AC50): parts and, by course, its grid slot from D_002A7F28 (rows 5 apart only on courses below 0x12; only the grid is reimplemented); in the Adventure on course 0x1C the player's car is D_0177EA5C (entry 3) with +0x194 = 3

name: Camera_CellVisible
note: whether a field cell centre (x, z) lies inside the camera's frustum lines (gfx::Model culls by bounding box instead)

name: Race_DrawView
note: a race view: Sky_Draw, field blocks in view, objects and cars, then block 64; lighting D_0177F720, TEST_2 D_0029CFC0 / D_0029CFF0

name: Sky_Draw
note: the sky model D_00290A40 around the camera (translation = eye with y 0), GS state D_0029D4A0

name: Race_Setup
note: sets up a race from the course table row (Quick Race D_002BE158): loads, the cars (Race_CreateCars), the race tasks; mode 8 (the attract demo): no HUD, meter or Race_Task, green at once, its own 22-car loop (Race::StartDemo, Race_CreateDemoCars)

name: Race_CreateViewTasks
note: Race_Setup's view tasks: Course_ObjectsTask (new every race), then mode 1 (2 Player, race flag 2): Camera_ChaseTask 2 and 3, func_00221300 1 and 2; else Camera_ChaseTask (mode 2: func_0021F098 instead) and func_00221300 0. The port's Race::Start covers it

name: Race_CreateCars
note: Car_Init for the player (slot cars-1), the save's teammates (flags 0x90/0xA0; none in Quick Race), then the course's opponents; Quick Race (flags 3): entry i in slot i, swapping 3/6 and 9/12; 2 Player: no opponents, players in slots 1/0 (5/4 with teams, teammates in 0-3); port's 2P part is Race_CreateVersusCars, the Adventure's Race_CreateAdventureCars (mode 0: the row's last six opponents from the back, then the rest from the front behind the teammates)

name: Loader_LoadCar
note: loads CARn/Qnn.BIN for record r: six section pointers to D_0177F310 + 0x18 r, GS uploads moved to TBP 0x243E + 0x44 r

name: Cars_Draw
note: every car's shadow (D_00290570, program 0x50, the car texture's bottom right quarter), then Car_Draw for those in view

name: Car_DrawLights
note: a car's lights (flags: 1 chain A of section n, the headlights; 2 chains B of sections 0 and 2, the brake lights), program 0x50 in the car's texture (TEX0_2 0x243E + 0x44 slot), after Cars_Draw's GS state for them (func_00223490: vf17 (1, 1, 0.5, 1), ALPHA_2 0x48 additive)

name: Car_Draw
note: one car: paint (record +0, D_0029D150 levels) to vf17/vf18, lights D_0177F620, body section 0 or 1 by distance, section 2/3 (part 0x1000), sections 4/5, the parts (PARTS.BIN models by flags 0-8 at D_002ED720's places; 6 the propellers), tires

name: Car_DrawTires
note: TIRE.BIN sections 0-2 at D_0029CAF0, turned by the wheel angles (car +0x80); texture TBP 0x1C44 + 2 rec[6] (the Wheels part's hub tile, PSMT4 blocks 2w, 2w+1), CLUT rec[5] (the wheel colour)

name: Car_Update
note: a car each frame: velocity to the car frame, gravity 0x59, quadratic drag, Car_Drive, move by v x 16/25, Car_Ground, Car_Crash, body tilt (+0x40, +0x74), wheels; parts 0x2000 (Car_Jet), 0x40 (the propellers in water), 0x1000 (the fins), 2 Player's drag (0x500 when +0x247 isn't 0); before the fins: the Flight Wing, part flag 4 to 8 over 300 km/h (Vec_SpeedKmh of +0xF0) and back under, in the parts record +0x184

name: Car_Input
note: the car input bits: Ai_TrackZone for every car with a path, then replay/record (race 0x40/0x20), the AI (D_003356DC = Ai_Drive, record flag 0x80) or the pad (Car_ReadPad); 0x100 autodrive, 0x800 brake; race 24 (the Endurance Run) in zone 0x66 before the last lap with the lap zone set: flag 0x400, the AI drives (bit 8 cleared), fuel +0x200 a frame to 0x40000, SE 0x309 on entry and 0x8309 on exit for flags 2 (Race::Race_PitStop)

name: Car_ReadPad
note: pad (car flags & 1) to car input via that record's key setup D_01780A48 + 0x3448 p: held keys 0-3 and 8 give 1, 2, 5, 8, 0x10, pressed keys 4-5 0x20/0x40, d-pad or stick 0x8000/0x2000; the horn key (6) starts the horn (+0x245) on its press and stops it on its release

name: Car_Drive
note: gearbox (D_003356D8), steering angle and turn radius, brake table, Car_Engine, driven wheel speed, yaw, local velocity to world, Car_Slide

name: Car_Engine
note: engine (torque, rev limit 9000, fuel) and tire coupling with a friction circle (grip x mass); new local velocity, rpm (+0x1D0), returns the squeal

name: Car_AutoGear
note: automatic gearbox (D_003356D8 in races): up over 8201, down under 5000/8000, reverse on Circle

name: Car_Slide
note: slide rate (+0x1D2) and angle (+0x1D6) when the turn exceeds the grip; decays with wheel speed

name: Car_Ground
note: 7 probes (D_0029CA80) against the PMP (D_00335710), Car_Suspension, height, up vector, orientation (+0x00, +0xB0); returns corner hits; Car_Suspension's reach is the fins' climb alone with part flag 8 (the Flight Wing out), else gravity +0xC plus climb (0x0021B5A8)

name: Car_Suspension
note: 3 springs (load +0x1DC, step +0x1E8, speed +0x1C0), walls beyond the clearance 0x51EB (0xA3D7 with part flag 0x400), roof under a unit

name: Car_LevelInAir
note: levels the up vector of an airborne car (or one on its bumpers) by 1/16 a frame

name: Car_Crash
note: after a hit: back two moves, old yaw, then push and velocity change by the corners hit (jump tables 0x2EADE0, 0x2EAE60); on course 0x1C every frame its own branch (jtbl 0x2EAE20, the port's Car_CrashTunnel): a set bounce, a second move, ACTION 0x11 at most every 0x20 frames (+0x212)

name: Car_SpinWheels
note: wheel spin and steering angles for drawing (+0x80..+0x88): speed / 0.33 front, / 0.38 rear, at most 0.8; with part flag 0x400 / 0.55 and at most 0.2

name: Car_SetParts
note: physics parameters from the parts record (+0x180): tires D_002ECA7C, engine D_002ECED0, weight D_002ED204, gears D_002ED334, steering D_002ED4F4, brakes D_002ED5DC; flags 0x30 (teammates): grip + grip/16, mass - mass/4

name: Cars_Collide
note: pairwise car collisions: overlapping cars pushed apart, x/z speeds averaged; func_00217830 sounds

name: Car_Overlaps
note: whether a car corner probe lies inside another car box (0.9 x 1.5)

name: Collision_Ground
note: the race ground query (D_00335710): PMP cell by x, z (100-unit cells), highest surface below layers; sets y and the water level

name: Collision_Strips
note: a PMP cell surfaces: point in triangle on x/z, height from the normal, layer (bit 31) and water (bit 28) surfaces

name: Matrix_FromUp
note: rotation rows from an up vector: x = (up.y, -up.x, 0) normalized, y = up, z = x cross y

name: Matrix_TurnY
note: turns a matrix by an angle about its own y (sceVu0RotMatrixY then MulMatrix)

name: Fixed_Rotate
note: fixed-point vector through a float rotation (itof15 / ftoi15)

name: Race_Task
note: the race each frame: HUD canvas and song at the start, then the clock (+0x20 while flags & 0x44 == 4), each car at the line and its lap time, the order, the HUD rows, the map and the meter, HudCanvas_Draw; race 24 (info+0x20): Hud_PittingBanner and Hud_GoBanner (0x0022E224)

name: Race_InitTimes
note: clears the lap records (D_01787068) and sets the best lap D_00335700 from the save (Quick Race: +0xB78 + 0xC card, the best lap; Adventure: +0x1040[course])

name: Race_CheckLapZones
note: a car at the line: three strips D_002A8198[course] move +0x19A to 2, 3, 4; strip 1 after 4 completes a lap; leaving strip 1 backwards sets 1

name: Race_CompleteLap
note: a lap done: the lap time (+0x260) into the last three, chime 0x2E or 0x2F for a new best (D_00335700), +0x19B laps; at the course laps the finish order (+0x247) and flags 0x280

name: Race_RankCars
note: the order (+0x247) of the cars still racing, after those finished: laps, line strip, AI path node +0x24B and distance +0x24C

name: Race_SetLapRows
note: the HUD lap rows of a player: the last laps (palette 0 if the best lap, else 12) and the running one

name: Race_CountdownTask
note: fade in over 0x40 frames; start lights (Hud_SetStartLights t/60+2), beeps 0x2D at 60, race flag 4 (green: clock, cars go) at 240, song and flag 0x100 at 300, lights off and flags 0x114 at 360

name: HudCanvas_Init
note: clears the 0x8CB0-byte HUD canvas and copies the element templates (D_002EC070...): one player or split screen, the car count

name: HudCanvas_Draw
note: draws the HUD canvas: start lights, headings, total time, lap rows, position, banners, sprites (SYS/SCORE.GSL, TEX0s D_0029F5F8)

name: Hud_SetStartLights
note: the start lights element (+0x800C, centre 320,64): lamp palettes (6/7 red, 8/9 green), glow fades and alphas for states 1-6

name: Hud_SetTotalTime
note: TOTALTIME heading and the race clock row at (60, 52)

name: Hud_SetLapRow
note: a player lap row: lap, time, style

name: Hud_SetPosition
note: a position element (player, slot 0 the player's, 1-2 the teammates'): visible and the order (0 = first)

name: Hud_DrawTimeRow
note: time rows: the bar, M'SS"CC as BCD (0 or 0x7FFFFFFF dashes), digits palette D_0029FCA8[style], lap badge (0 = BEST)

name: Hud_DrawPosition
note: position: large digits, st/nd/rd/th, the circle and /cars

name: Meter_Draw
note: runs the player meter routine D_002A8FB0[meter part] (meter 10 in split screen); the clock on the field (course -1 or 0x22)

name: Meter_Draw0
note: METER0: fuel strips (pivot 70,70), dial, gear, mph digits (D_00332F48 1.609), needle (rpm/10000 - 0.7) pi, hub; clock and slope parts

name: Meter_Rpm
note: car +0x1D0 scaled/clamped to 10000

name: Meter_Fuel
note: car +0x23C scaled/clamped to 0x40000

name: Meter_Speed
note: speed across the ground (216 x |v.xz| / 32768 km/h) / 1.609 as BCD

name: Meter_Gear
note: car +0x1FF

name: Meter_ClockDigits
note: the field clock: frames / 150 (minutes) as BCD HH:MM with a colon (0xA), drawn from the right by Meter_Draw0 (picture 1 palette 12 at (91 - 9 i, 122))

name: Meter_ClockIcon
note: the field clock picture by time of day: 0 moon to 0xE483 and after 0x278D0, 1 sun to 0x2327F, 2 evening (METER0 picture 0 at u 140 + 24 n, v 49)

name: RaceMap_Draw
note: the course map D_0177AB78 part 1 through a top-down camera at D_002A4050[course] (x, y, scale, angle), colour D_002A4350; with the debug byte pad 2 tunes the view first (the Map Tuner extra, RaceMap_Tune)

name: RaceMap_DrawCars
note: map markers: player arrow D_00290870 turned by yaw (red), others D_00290940 (green), teammates (flags 0x30) cyan, red with 0x40

name: Hud_DrawStartLights
note: start lights: panel (D_002EBCE0/D_002EBD00/D_002EBD20, palette 6), 8 lamps (UV 112,184), glows from SCORE picture 2 fading +0x40 in / -0x20 out a frame

name: Ai_Init
note: the car's AI path: D_002BD578[course] {gates +0x250, zones +0x254} (0x0B uses 0x06, 0x10 0x0F), speed table +0x258 (Quick Race D_002A9B80[D_002AC098[D_002AC080[course]]], teammates D_01780A60 + 0x1000 for flag 0x20, + 0x3448 for 0x40), zone marks +0x25C = D_01759D70[car]; in mode 0 (the Adventure) a car not on a team gets D_002A9B80 + race x 0x100 (race/adventure_speeds.inc, gen_adventure_speeds.py)

name: Ai_TargetAngles
note: 16-bit angles from the car to a gate's two edges, by lane (+0x194 & 3): whole gate, middle to second end (1), first end to middle (2)

name: Ai_TrackZone
note: moves +0x24A to the zone the car is in by the gates' side tests (split lines at forks); +0x24B rank, +0x24C distance to the next zone's far gate, +0x248 wrong-way frames; returns the next zone; ZONE/TARGET LINE debug text

name: Ai_Drive
note: AI input bits: accelerate/coast/brake against the zone's speed (5 km/h) and the cap +0x246 (2.5 km/h), steer for the next zone's far gate (0x2000/0x8000 once +0x19A is set), turn 0x100 a frame on the spot if more than a quarter turn off; marks the zone (+0x25C: 0x80 steered / 0x40 not, OR the speed); with its last argument (a teammate) first moves the zone's speed in the saved table by the marks

name: Ai_CopySpeedTables
note: copies the 16 speed tables D_002A9B80[D_002AC098[i]] to a save area (the teammates' tables in the save, D_01780A60 = record +0x1300; Ai_Drive changes them)

name: Ai_DrawZoneTable
note: debug: 13 columns of 20 zones, only the car's zone's (+0x24A / 20) and those either side; row r at y 8r + 64, '>' at x 80c + 24 on the car's zone (not wrapped: off the screen from zone 160), and for a non-zero speed (+0x258) "%c %3d %3d" (D_00328050) at x 80 (c & 7) + 32: the mark (+0x25C & 0xC0: 0x40 O, 0x80 X, else blank), speed x 5, mark speed (& 0x3F) x 5; debug font colour 15

name: Hud_SetFinish
note: FINISH! (canvas +0x8590, element type 3: picture 1 D_0029F6E8 at (320, 112), zooming to scale 1 over 30 frames)

name: Hud_SetFinalLap
note: FINAL LAP (canvas +0x85BC, element type 1: picture 1 D_0029F708 at (320, 112)); Race_Task blinks it with +0x27 & 8

name: Hud_SetWrongWay
note: WRONG WAY (canvas +0x8538: D_0029F768 palette 1 at (320, 135), the U-turn arrow D_0029F788 palette 5 at (320, 92))

name: HudCanvas_InitReplay
note: clears the HUD canvas for the replay, keeping only REPLAY (template D_002EC1D8: picture 1 D_0029F748 palette 4 at (100, 44))

name: Hud_DrawElements
note: draws 0x2C-byte canvas elements: type 1 a centred sprite list, 2 a rocking sprite, 3 a sprite zooming in over +0x24 frames to scale +0x28

name: Race_ReplayTaskInit
note: Race_Task after the finish: starts the song (the replay's), HudCanvas_InitReplay, recomputes +0x25, then Race_ReplayTask

name: Race_ReplayTask
note: the replay's race task: lap zones and times only; at the player's finish (+0x25 & 9) or Start, race flag 8 and Race_ReplayFadeOut

name: Race_ReplayFadeOut
note: black overlay t << 24 over 0x80 frames, then the parent's result (-1)

name: Race_SetupTask
note: the race's parent after Race_Setup: pause (Start), final lap (flag 0x10: Replay_Save, flag 0x20), after the finish the replay (place < 6, not courses 0x0F/0x10: REPLAY song, flags 0x10044) or the results (Results_Task, GrandPrix results)

name: Replay_Save
note: race flag 0x10: copies the 24 car records to 0x100000 and starts the input recording (+0x44-0x4C run-length lists)

name: Replay_Restore
